title: StoneHeart
description: Stoneheart is a thrilling Minecraft server combining Box PvP, Economy, Lifesteal, and Skyblock. Battle friends in fast-paced PvP arenas, grow your wealth in the Economy, survive intense Lifesteal challenges, and build your dream Skyblock island. Adventure,
body: Welcome to Stoneheart, the Minecraft server that has it all! Jump into Box PvP arenas to test your combat skills, grow your wealth with our Economy, survive thrilling Lifesteal challenges, and build your dream in Skyblock. With active staff, friendly players, and regular updates, there’s never a dull moment. Adventure, strategy, and fun await—are you ready to join?
